# DATA
## HISTORICAL
### TURNOUT
```{r}
historical_turnout <- read_csv("../data/processed/historical_midterm_turnout.csv")
```
### DEMOGRAPHICS
```{r}
historical_demographics <- read_csv("../data/processed/historical_demographics.csv")
```



### COMBINE
```{r}
historical_data <- historical_turnout |>
  left_join(historical_demographics, join_by(year, county)) |>
  filter(party == "ALL")

remove(historical_turnout, historical_demographics)
```

## 2026
### ELIGIBLE
```{r}
eligible_voters_2026 <- read_csv("../data/processed/2026_eligible_voters.csv")
```

### EARLY
```{r}
early_voting_2026 <- read_csv("../data/processed/2026_early_voting.csv")
```

### DEMOGRAPHICS
```{r}
demographics_2026 <- read_csv("../data/processed/2026_demographics.csv")
```

### COMBINE
```{r}
data_2026 <- eligible_voters_2026 |>
  left_join(early_voting_2026, join_by(year, county, eligible_voters)) |>
  left_join(demographics_2026, join_by(year, county)) |>
  filter(party == "ALL")

remove(eligible_voters_2026, early_voting_2026, demographics_2026)
```


# REVISED MODEL

```{r}
final_fit <- glm(
  cbind(turnout, eligible_voters - turnout) ~ pct_black + pct_early + median_household_income,
  family = quasibinomial, 
  data = historical_data
)
summary(final_fit)
```


```{r}
f <- cbind(turnout, eligible_voters - turnout) ~ pct_black + pct_early + median_household_income

years <- c("2010", "2014", "2018", "2022")

backtest <- map(years, \(h) {
  fit <- glm(f, family = quasibinomial, 
             data = filter(historical_data, year != h))
  filter(historical_data, year == h) |>
    mutate(predicted = predict(fit, pick(everything()), type = "response"))
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  select(year, county, pct_turnout, predicted) |>
  mutate(resid = pct_turnout - predicted)

# County spread, shrunk toward the pooled spread.
# k = how many "pseudo-elections" of weight the statewide SD gets.
pooled_sd <- sd(backtest$resid)
k <- 4

county_scale <- backtest |>
  group_by(county) |>
  summarise(n_yrs = n(),
            bias  = mean(resid),
            sd_c  = sd(resid)) |>
  mutate(scale = sqrt((k * pooled_sd^2 + (n_yrs - 1) * sd_c^2) /
                      (k + n_yrs - 1)))

# Standardize, take one pair of quantiles, rescale per county
backtest <- backtest |>
  left_join(county_scale, by = "county") |>
  mutate(z = resid / scale)

qz <- quantile(backtest$z, c(0.05, 0.95))

# Check coverage on the backtest (should be near 90%)
backtest |>
  mutate(lo = predicted + qz[1] * scale,
         hi = predicted + qz[2] * scale) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(pct_turnout >= lo & pct_turnout <= hi))

# Apply to the forecast (fit on all years)
final_fit <- glm(f, family = quasibinomial, data = historical_data)

revised_forecast <- data_2026 |>
  mutate(predicted = predict(final_fit, pick(everything()), type = "response")) |>
  left_join(county_scale, by = "county") |>
  mutate(lo = predicted + qz[1] * scale,
         hi = predicted + qz[2] * scale)
```
